title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
provenance: Reported by Jirawat2307 (upstream#181, 2026-09-22): rated 5, perfect, Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, KLYC-Box 0.9.32, DXMT with the Metal HUD on and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, 39 minutes played through KLYC-Box, and in a follow-up comment the HUD hovering around 110 to 120 fps. masxsimo2003 (upstream#311, 2026-10-04), Apple M4, macOS 15.7.9, KLYC-Box 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, DXMT, recipe steam, rated 5 of 5 after 221 minutes, with fullscreen covered by the camera as the one flaw. Not run here.
notes: Reported perfect twice on DXMT on the default engine. On an M4 Pro with macOS 26.6.2 and engine r5 the Metal HUD hovered around 110 to 120 fps over a 39-minute session, by the reporter's follow-up. On an M4 with macOS 15.7.9, KLYC-Box 0.10.3 and engine r19 a 221-minute session was perfect apart from fullscreen being covered by the camera, the MacBook's notch cutting into the picture, the same thing a Dimraeth report saw. The anti-cheat map has no entry for this game and neither reporter mentions a kick or a ban. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: In fullscreen the picture runs under the MacBook's camera notch (reported on an M4, macOS 15.7.9, DXMT, engine r19)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game fills the whole screen including the strip beside the camera, as Dimraeth does
knownIssues.fix: None confirmed on this game. On Dimraeth, with the same symptom, playing windowed worked
